title: Count the keystrokes actually saved
hook: Two stated cases: explore the metric boundary for an autocomplete saving.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the metric boundary for an autocomplete saving affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Saved, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the metric boundary for an autocomplete saving in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
